currentStory.title: The Sneezing Kid Who Became a Bouncy Ball
currentStory.hook: Kid sneezes—BAM! He becomes a glowing rubber ball!
currentStory.part1Summary: A tiny sneeze erupts, and boom—kid explodes into a neon bouncy ball! *ghop ghop gop* it ricochets across the sky, bouncing off clouds, while Sheru Bhai lunges with his million‑dollar magnet‑net, shouting ‘Catch me if you can!’ *boing boing boing* Part 2 drops TONIGHT at 7:30 PM EST! 🍿
currentStory.cliffhanger: The ball rockets toward a glowing portal as Sheru Bhai’s net snaps shut—will he catch it?

completedSeries.title: The Sneezing Bouncy Ball Blitz
completedSeries.cliffhanger: Sheru Bhai lunges, but the ball bursts into a swirling portal—what's on the other side? Find out tomorrow!
completedSeries.finaleSummary: Part 2! In our last episode Sheru Bhai lunged, but the neon ball burst into a swirling portal—*GHOP GHOP GOP!*—and out popped a million‑dollar trampoline that flung Timmy into reverse gravity orbit! He spins like a disco pizza, lands on a candy‑cloud, and poof! Transforms back into a giggling kid‑ball hybrid holding a glittery jackpot trophy. Sheru Bhai screams, "My magnet‑net just turned into a confetti cannon!" End scene with a triumphant shout: What should transform in tomorrow's saga? Drop it in the comments! 👇

completedSeries.title: The Boy Who Turned Into a Bouncy Ball
